instruction: Use the AI template recommendation system to automatically suggest and apply a professional layout based on the document's content.

metadata.explanation: LibreOffice Writer does not have AI-powered template recommendation or automatic layout suggestion features. While templates can be manually selected and applied, there is no intelligent content-based template matching system.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - the instruction requests AI-powered template recommendation which does not exist in LibreOffice Writer
